description:
You unleash a devastating astral frost blast in a wide cone up to 8 tiles away, dealing ::damage ::damage_type damage with powerful astral force.
The surge pierces all targets, inflicts frostbite, burns 35 stamina, knocks enemies back, and immobilizes those caught in the blast.
Each cast builds Astral Fatigue stacks, increasing this spell’s damage by 3 per stack, but overuse triggers severe astral backlash.
This spell ignores party members and cannot be dodged.
name: Astral Collapse
